name: Bookmark Miner
tagline: Turns the X posts you saved into a ranked list of things actually worth doing
description: Everyone saves posts they never revisit. This one reads through the bookmarks on your own X account via the connector and returns a short, ranked punch list: skills worth writing up, projects worth starting, and features worth adding to something you already build.
author: therookiehacker
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
